title: Preoperational Fine Needle Aspiration of Pathological Parathyroid Gland
brief_summary: Identification and localization of pathological parathyroid gland before parathyroidectomy is traditionally done by a combination of two methods: ultrasound and sestamibi scan. The investigators would like to show that one exam that includes ultrasound and fine needle aspiration of the parathyroid gland for parathyroid hormone level is as accurate as the traditional method.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* above 18 years old
* participants that suffer from primary hyperparathyroidism with an indication for parathyroidectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronic renal failure
* kidney transplant participant
* MEN (multiple endocrine neoplasia) syndrome
* pregnancy
